contacts.notes: Head of Training Data at Luminary AI, one of the top foundation model labs. First engaged at NeurIPS Data Workshop in January. Closed a 500K image captioning dataset deal in Q2 — their internal annotation team couldn't scale fast enough. Now on a monthly data subscription for incremental multimodal content. Key decision-maker; works closely with their VP of AI Research. Prefers async Slack-style updates and monthly check-ins.

VP of AI Research at Luminary AI, executive sponsor on the Wirestock relationship. Introduced by Dmitri Voronov after the initial dataset deal closed. Involved in budget decisions for Q1 2027 data roadmap — has appetite for expanding into video captioning datasets. Attended our AI Data Summit webinar in August.

Director of Computer Vision at TerraDrive, a Series D AV company. Reached via LinkedIn outbound after they posted a job req for a Data Acquisition Engineer — a signal they had budget. Currently scoping a large urban driving scene collection for Q4 delivery. Needs geo-diverse footage across 12 cities. Deal in contract review. Champion internally; working with their legal team on data licensing terms.

ML Data Lead at TerraDrive, technical evaluator on the urban driving scene collection deal. Evaluating Wirestock's metadata quality standards against their internal specs. Sent annotated sample batch in early September — feedback was very positive. Will be the day-to-day contact post-close.

Head of Data at NeuraBot, a well-funded robotics startup focused on manipulation tasks. Inbound from our 'Custom Data Commission vs Off-the-Shelf' blog post. Needs video datasets showing human hand manipulation across diverse object types and environments — very specific brief. Proposal sent for a $185K manipulation task video dataset. Technical team loved the sample reels from our creator pool.

Data Partnerships Lead at ContextIQ, an ad tech platform using CV for contextual ad targeting. Referred by a mutual contact at Index Ventures. Looking for a bulk content licensing bundle — primarily lifestyle and commercial photography. Budget is $60K-$100K for a one-year license. Responded well to our catalog overview. Scheduling a deep-dive demo.

Chief AI Officer at ClarityML, an enterprise AI company building domain-specific models for financial services and legal verticals. Inbound from our website after downloading the AI Data Sourcing Guide. Closed a content licensing deal in Q1 ($95K/yr). Now on a monthly data subscription for ongoing document and image data. Expansion opportunity: annotation services for their legal document pipeline.

Head of Data at PixelForge, a generative AI image startup (text-to-image model). Found Wirestock on Product Hunt during our dataset catalog launch. Very interested in licensed photographic content for training their diffusion model — needs broad aesthetic diversity. Scoping a $120K content licensing bundle. Moving fast; wants to close before end of Q3 to hit their next training run.

VP of AI Research at MediVision AI, a healthcare AI company focused on diagnostic imaging. Met at CVPR in June. Evaluating Wirestock for medical image annotation services — radiology and pathology datasets. Deal would be substantial ($200K+) but procurement process is lengthy. Currently in discovery; need to loop in their compliance team.

Research Engineer at SonicAI, a speech AI company building multilingual ASR models. Inbound via the 'Request a Dataset Sample' form after downloading our audio transcription sample pack. Needs a large-scale multilingual audio dataset with transcriptions — 20 languages, 500 hours each. Proposal scoped at $310K. Very technically rigorous in their quality bar; sent detailed spec sheet.

ML Data Lead at Luminary AI, day-to-day data operations contact. Works directly under Dmitri Voronov. Manages the monthly data subscription pipeline — coordinates delivery specs, format requirements, and QA sign-off. Very process-oriented; has standardised the intake form with our team. Strong relationship; likely advocate for renewal and expansion.

Director of Computer Vision at NeuraBot, co-sponsor with Mei-Lin Huang on the manipulation task video dataset deal. Reviews quality of annotations and bounding box accuracy. Satisfied with pilot batch results. Will co-sign the statement of work.

Head of Data at ClarityML, operational counterpart to Ingrid Voss. Manages the day-to-day data subscription relationship — sends monthly delivery specs, QA feedback, and handles invoicing. Interested in expanding the annotation services scope. Good relationship; send him the quarterly product update newsletter.

Head of Training Data at ScaleVision, a computer vision startup. Outbound prospect who engaged through a strong discovery call but ultimately went with Scale AI for their annotation pipeline. Primary reasons cited: Scale AI's existing tooling integrations and faster turnaround SLA. Keep warm for Q1 2027 — they mentioned Scale AI's pricing would be reviewed at renewal. Follow up in January.

Chief AI Officer at ContextIQ, executive stakeholder behind Arjun Sharma's data partnership evaluation. Joined the second discovery call and expressed strong interest in a bulk content licensing bundle for their contextual ad model. Budget authority confirmed. Looped in for the formal proposal presentation scheduled for mid-October.

deals.notes: Closed in 115 days. Luminary AI needed 500K image-caption pairs for vision-language model training. Wirestock recruited 340 photographers across 28 countries to deliver diverse, high-quality imagery with CLIP-style captions. Delivered in 3 batches; final QA pass was 98.6%. Directly led to the data subscription expansion.

ClarityML needed a rights-cleared image library for training their document and enterprise AI models. Closed a $95K/year content licensing bundle covering 2.4M assets across document photography, UI/UX screenshots, and business scenes. Auto-renews in March 2027; early expansion conversation started.

deals.deal_name: Luminary AI — Monthly Multimodal Data Subscription
deals.notes: Monthly data subscription following the DL01 image captioning dataset success. Delivering 30K new images and 8 hours of annotated video per month, formatted to Luminary's spec. Month-over-month, Valentina Cruz handles delivery intake. Currently in month 3; renewal checkpoint in December. MRR $28K.

deals.deal_name: TerraDrive — Urban Driving Scene Collection Q4
deals.notes: TerraDrive needs geo-diverse urban driving footage for their next training run — 12 cities, focusing on intersections, pedestrian crossings, and adverse weather. Wirestock has 900+ vetted videographers in target cities. SOW covers 600 hours of raw footage plus 2D bounding box annotation. Contract in legal review; expected to close by end of October.

NeuraBot needs video datasets of human hand manipulation for robotics training. Proposal covers 1,200 video clips across 200 object types, shot from 3 angles, with per-frame keypoint annotation. Pilot batch of 50 clips was approved with minor feedback. Full proposal sent September 15. Champion Mei-Lin Huang is pushing for internal approval.

SonicAI needs 500 hours of audio per language across 20 languages, with word-level transcriptions and speaker metadata. Wirestock is scoping creator recruitment across target language markets. Technical spec review is ongoing — Curtis Nakamura sent a detailed quality rubric. Scoping call scheduled for October 8.

PixelForge is licensing a curated photography collection for diffusion model training — needs 800K images with style and aesthetic diversity tags. Proposal for a $120K one-year license sent September 10. Tobias Reinhardt has budget authority and wants to move before Q4 training run. Verbal agreement on pricing; formal proposal under review.

ClarityML wants to expand their existing relationship into annotation services — specifically entity extraction labeling on legal and financial documents. Pradeep Subramaniam is scoping the workload (est. 500K pages). This is an upsell from the existing content licensing relationship. Scoping call completed; working on SOW.

ClarityML's monthly data subscription is up for renewal at end of year. Ingrid Voss confirmed intent to renew with a modest volume increase (from 20K to 28K images/month). Renewal proposal to include expanded annotation coverage. Targeting a multi-year renewal with a 5% volume discount. MRR $22K.

ContextIQ is evaluating a bulk content licensing bundle for contextual ad model training. Arjun Sharma confirmed a budget of $60K-$100K for a one-year license. Discovery call completed; demo of catalog API scheduled for October. Marcus Webb (CAO) has budget authority. Partner referral from Index Ventures increases deal confidence.

Lost to Scale AI in July. ScaleVision cited Scale AI's existing CVAT tooling integration and a 48-hour turnaround SLA we couldn't match at that time. Price was comparable. Nadia Petrov said pricing review is in January 2027 — schedule re-engagement in Q1. Good relationship maintained; no hard feelings.

Orbital Labs inbound lead from LinkedIn — their Head of Research saw our post on egocentric video datasets. Early discovery stage; initial call confirmed they need 800 hours of egocentric video across diverse activities and environments for embodied AI research. Budget approval expected in November. Assigning contact owner after initial meeting next week.

sequences.name: AI Lab Data Partnership Outreach
sequences.description: 6-step outbound sequence targeting Head of Data and ML Data Leads at foundation model labs and applied AI research companies. Leads with Wirestock's scale (200K+ vetted creators, 50+ countries) and proof points from existing lab partnerships. Step 3 includes a link to our dataset catalog and a 'request a sample' CTA. Best performers: LinkedIn voice note on step 4 and a case study email on step 6.

sequences.name: Computer Vision Dataset Discovery
sequences.description: 5-step discovery sequence for Director of Computer Vision and ML Data Lead roles at companies actively training vision models. Email 1 opens with a benchmark on annotation quality vs in-house pipelines. Email 3 shares a short video walkthrough of our annotation platform. Final step is a calendar invite for a 20-minute dataset scoping call. Strong open rates among AV and robotics segments.

sequences.name: Post-Trial Conversion
sequences.description: 4-step conversion sequence for contacts who have received and reviewed a free sample dataset. Step 1 goes out 48 hours after sample delivery with a quality feedback survey. Step 2 (day 5) presents a formal proposal. Step 3 (day 10) offers a 1:1 with the data engineering team. Step 4 is a final urgency email around the prospect's stated training timeline. Highest reply rate of all active sequences.

sequences.name: Autonomous Vehicle Data Nurture
sequences.description: 7-step long-cycle nurture sequence for AV companies that require continuous, high-volume, geo-diverse scene data. Content focuses on Wirestock's geographic creator coverage, fleet diversity, and ability to commission edge-case scenarios on demand. Includes a city-by-city coverage map asset and a TerraDrive-inspired case study outline. Step 7 invites prospects to our quarterly AV Data Roundtable.

sequences.name: Generative AI Content Licensing
sequences.description: 5-step outbound sequence targeting Head of Data and legal/licensing contacts at generative AI image and video companies. Leads with Wirestock's creator consent framework and fully licensed-for-AI-training asset library — a key differentiator vs scraped web content. Step 2 links to our legal FAQ on AI training licensing. Step 4 offers a catalog browse session with a licensing specialist.
